note: D7 per-route first-load budgets measured from the real Next build (`next build` → client reference manifest + build manifest). The recorded size is the measured baseline; the allowance is the growth permitted over it before the build fails (ordinary work must not need a new baseline, a new dependency must). Forbidden libraries must stay lazy. Large lazy chunks are recorded by a stable content marker plus a reason, because hashed filenames change every build. Run `node scripts/console-bundle-budgets.mjs` after `next build`.
